# pve_sdn_route_map (Data Source)

Reads one SDN route map and its ordered entries from `GET /cluster/sdn/route-maps/entries/{route-map-id}`. Entries carry their upstream index in `order`; evaluation walks them in index order and the first match wins.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.

data "pve_sdn_route_map" "rm1" {
  route_map_id = "rm1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `route_map_id` (String) The SDN route map identifier to look up.

### Read-Only

- `entries` (Attributes List) The route map entries in upstream order. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--entries))
- `id` (String) Identifier of the route map; equals the `route_map_id`.

<a id="nestedatt--entries"></a>
### Nested Schema for `entries`

Read-Only:

- `action` (String) Matching policy of the entry: `permit` or `deny`.
- `call` (String) Route map jumped to when the entry matches; null when unset.
- `exit_action` (Attributes) What to do after the entry matches; the pin's `exit-action` field. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--entries--exit_action))
- `match` (Attributes List) Ordered match clauses; the route must satisfy every clause. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--entries--match))
- `order` (Number) Entry index assigned by PVE (0-65535); orders entry evaluation.
- `set` (Attributes List) Ordered set clauses applied to matching routes. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--entries--set))

<a id="nestedatt--entries--exit_action"></a>
### Nested Schema for `entries.exit_action`

Read-Only:

- `key` (String) Exit behavior: `on-match-goto`, `on-match-next`, or `continue`.
- `value` (Number) Target entry index for `on-match-goto`; null when unset.


<a id="nestedatt--entries--match"></a>
### Nested Schema for `entries.match`

Read-Only:

- `key` (String) Route property to match.
- `value` (String) Value the key matches on; key-dependent.


<a id="nestedatt--entries--set"></a>
### Nested Schema for `entries.set`

Read-Only:

- `key` (String) Route property to set.
- `value` (String) Value to set the key to; key-dependent.
